Frequently Asked Questions

How does this love quiz work?
You answer together 20 statements by rating your level of agreement from 1 to 5. Debate if necessary to find a consensus!
How long does the quiz take?
About 10 to 15 minutes, depending on how much time you take to discuss each statement. Take your time!
Is the quiz really free?
Yes, 100% free and no registration required. Your answers are not saved, you can retake the quiz as many times as you want.
What does our score mean?
Your score reflects your level of agreement on key aspects of the relationship. A high score indicates strong harmony, but it's just a fun indicator!
